📝 Admissions & Admission Process

1) Eligibility: As per VTU & AICTE norms — 10+2 (Science) with required physics, chemistry & mathematics. Lateral entry available for diploma holders.

2) Entrance / Selection: Admissions are through state & national processes (KCET / COMEDK / DCET where applicable) and management quota as per institute rules. Merit based counselling/seat allotment follows the respective counselling authority.

3) How to Apply: Apply via the official portals (KCET/COMEDK) or the MMEC admission portal. For management quota, contact the admissions office directly.

4) Documents Required: 10th/12th marksheets, transfer & migration certificate, degree/diploma (for lateral entry), caste & income certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar, passport-size photos, and proof of entrance rank (if applicable).

5) Fees & Payment: Fees differ by quota — refer to the official fee schedule. Payments accepted via online banking, UPI or bank challan. For queries, call admissions helpline.

6) Contact & Next Steps: Visit MMEC Admissions or call the admissions office at 9353364643. For step-by-step guidance, mention "admission process" and the campus team will assist you.

📝 Admission Process — Step by Step

• Step 1 — Check Eligibility: Ensure you meet the eligibility criteria (10+2 with PCM or relevant diploma for lateral entry).
• Step 2 — Entrance/Registration: Register/apply through the relevant counselling portal (KCET/COMEDK/DCET) or the MMEC admission portal for institute-level seats.
• Step 3 — Document Verification: Attend document verification with original certificates (10th, 12th, transfer/migration, Aadhaar, caste/income if applicable).
• Step 4 — Seat Allotment & Payment: On allotment, pay the fees as per your quota (merit/management) to confirm admission.
• Step 5 — Reporting & Orientation: Report to the college on the specified date for registration, orientation, and class commencement.

For any confusion, contact the Admissions Office at 9353364643 or visit MMEC Admissions.
